generations.text: Daniel Natarajan contacted support because the Pulse Band will not sync with the phone since 2025-12-25. It is a Medium priority case and the status is currently Closed. The agent offered a repair of $575.00. The customer confirmed order ORD-51254 and asked for a replacement. The knowledge base notes that Pulse Band step counts are recalibrated after a 2-day wear period. The customer seems satisfied with the proposed next step.
